plumage.size_unit: observed tips on a rooted tree

accuracy: Count a map only if every contour cell matches, a tree only if every internal node's full set of globally optimal states matches, and a circuit only if every requested Pauli expectation matches. Each held-out circuit has eight queries.
additional_checks: Named worked cases are frozen before the GPU submission and excluded from held-out scores and timing.
timing: Three synchronized FP32 forward sweeps over all 64 GPU-resident records of each size in batches of eight, following one warm-up batch. Excludes encoding, transfers, decoding, validation and disk I/O.
